title: Blaise Kelly
text:
Energy is the thread that connects CO2 emissions, noise, air pollution, cost of living and road safety. Active Analytics is an independent consultancy specialising in reproducible and transparent analysis of the data behind this. From dispersion modelling and meteorological data processing to publication standard and interactive plots and simple dissemination websites.

title: About
text:
Blaise has been working on transport, building and air quality modelling for >15 years. He has excellent knowledge of reproducible data analysis with R.
air quality — dispersion modelling (AERMOD/ADMS), CAMS wildfire PM10 evaluation, NO2 trend/changepoint analysis, met-normalised cycling infrastructure study
road safety — STATS19 local authority reports, the Wiltshire 50→40mph appraisal, TAG economic assessment
active travel — cycling infrastructure (Barcelona OSM evolution, pop-up lanes/NO2 work), walking/cycling policy
transport — the broader umbrella when it’s not specifically active modes
meteorology — ERA5 preprocessing pipeline, worldmet/NOAA gap-filling, boundary layer work
spatial analysis — LiDAR (solar potential, z0/displacement height), OSM analysis, general GIS
reproducible reporting — Quarto pipelines, automated report generation, GitHub Pages publishing
R — package development (nexurbr, stats19_stats contributions), Shiny apps (the mapgl spatial audit tool, BAC calculator)
dispersion modelling
